# NitroPush organization profile

Public branding and links for [github.com/nitropush](https://github.com/nitropush).

GitHub renders [`profile/README.md`](profile/README.md) on the organization's Overview page. Assets live in `profile/assets/`; links use absolute public URLs so they work from both the organization page and this repository.

## Editing

1. Change the profile copy or assets in a pull request.
2. Keep NativeScript marked **alpha** until its support status changes.
3. Check the linked website, documentation routes, and public repositories.
4. Verify every image has descriptive alternative text and works on light and dark GitHub themes.
5. Merge to `main` to update the public profile.

Only public profile assets belong here. Do not add credentials, private service details, deployment files, or generated app builds. No organization-wide community defaults or automation are configured by this repository.

See [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md) for branding sources and the hero artwork prompt.
